scripts.dev: concurrently -n "shared,api,web" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w @agentos/shared" "npm run dev -w @agentos/api" "npm run dev -w @agentos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentos/shared && npm run build -w @agentos/api && npm run build -w @agentos/web
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
